t: You're looking at the monument to Prince Lee Boo, which stands in the churchyard of St Mary's, just west of the church tower. It commemorates a young man from Palau, in the Pacific, the second son of the ruler of Koror. He was one of the first Pacific Islanders to visit Britain. He came to London after the Antelope was wrecked on Palau in 1783 and Captain Henry Wilson agreed to bring him, so that he could learn more about Europe. He died in 1784, aged about twenty.
